data.narrative:
Archer Materials is a public-stage quantum computing company founded by Mohammad Choucair, currently valued at A$59.9M (~US$39M) following total capital raised of $25M+. The quantum computing sector comprises a comp universe of 11 identifiable peers: 3 public entities (IonQ, Rigetti Computing, D-Wave Quantum) and 8 private companies including Quantinuum and Infleqtion.

Valuation analysis relies on peer-median methodology across four same-sector, same-stage comparables. IonQ trades at $13.0B, D-Wave Quantum at $6.3B, Rigetti Computing at $4.5B, and Infleqtion at $1.9B, establishing a peer median of $5.4B and a range spanning $1.9B to $13.0B. This peer-median approach implies a valuation of $5.4B for Archer Materials, representing the primary triangulation method available from the dataset.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4.6B (low) to $6.2B (high) centered on a $5.4B median. This implies Archer trades at a substantial discount to peer medians despite equivalent public-stage status within the same subsector. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer set given marked valuation dispersion ($1.9B to $13.0B), the comparability of technical maturity and commercial progress across quantum hardware approaches, and whether Archer's current market capitalization reflects material execution or funding gaps relative to higher-valued peers.
